issue.title: Gate follow-up launch failures are silent: approval settles but no notification says the follow-up agent never launched
issue.description:
When a settled gate shell's follow-up agent fails to launch, the failure is recorded
only in the shell member's `agent_meta.json` (`gate_followup_outcome: not-launchable`,
`gate_followup_error: ...`, prompt stashed to `gate_followup_prompt.md`) by
`record_followup_not_launchable` (`src/sase/shells/followup.py`) via
`launch_shell_followup`'s exception handlers. No notification, inbox entry, or desktop
alert is produced.

Observed impact on 2026-09-04: a regression (`ValueError: agent name must not be empty`
from the typed-owner-identity Rust bindings, fixed separately) made every tale-plan
coder follow-up not-launchable. Two TUI plan approvals (`p--plan`, `q--plan`,
project gh_sase-org__sase) "succeeded" — plan archived, gate settled TALE APPROVED —
but no coder ever ran. The user discovered it only by noticing the absence of coder
agents and had to launch coders manually; the diagnosing agent had to dig into
gate-shell artifact metas to find the recorded error.

Desired remediation: surface a follow-up launch failure through the SASE notification
inbox (and the desktop-notification pathway plan gates already use, cf.
`send_desktop_notification` in `sase/main/plan_approve_handler.py`), including the
saved `gate_followup_prompt.md` path so a user or agent can relaunch by hand. The TUI
already models `gate_followup_error` on agent rows
(`src/sase/ace/tui/models/_agent_state.py`), so a visible badge may partly exist —
the gap is the push notification at settlement time when nobody is looking at that row.

task_type_fields.impact: Approved plans silently never execute; users lose hours before noticing and must exhume gate-shell artifact metas to find the error
task_type_fields.repro: Approve a tale plan while the coder spawn path raises (e.g. pre-fix EmptyAgentName regression of 2026-09-04); gate settles TALE APPROVED, agent_meta.json gets gate_followup_error, but no notification/inbox entry is created

payload.description: Both are gate-shell lifecycle observability gaps: sase-wp is silent follow-up launch failure, this is an unattributable propose-to-gate stall
